hints.title: Parent-Child Degree Difference
hints.text: Every node in a tree except the root appears exactly once as a child of another node.

hints.title: Value Summation or Parity Invariant
hints.text: The sum of all node values minus the sum of all children values equals the root value.

hints.title: Matching Node Retrieval
hints.text: Iterate through the node list and return the node whose value matches the net difference.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Iterates through all nodes and edges twice, requiring O(1) auxiliary space beyond the inputs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Storing parent sets uses O(N) extra memory when arithmetic difference identifies the root directly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Summing values avoids hash set allocation while maintaining linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: O(1) extra space arithmetic tracking of in-degree sums across tree nodes.
